task: Matrix Report: Separate Site (Plan) from Warehouse (Inventory)

key_achievements: Separated Sites and Warehouses in the Matrix Report API and UI.
Implemented 'Peak Plan' view for Projects (Sites) to drive Action/Return logic.
Implemented 'Inventory' view for Warehouses (Hubs) for stock visibility only.
Refined analytics calculation to exclude Warehouse locations from triggering 'Returns' or 'Demands'.
Updated UI with clear section headers and color-coding for Sites vs Warehouses.
